overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter delivering premium dehydrated neem powder from India. Our 6-step production process covers sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch. We process carefully selected green leaves to maintain a natural green color, uniform particle size, and consistent moisture levels for international industrial formulation requirements.

We supply global distributors, personal care formulators, and agricultural manufacturers with reliable bulk quantities and private label options. Standard production features an 80-100 mesh size with moisture levels controlled at or below eight percent. With complete batch traceability, flexible minimum orders starting at 5 Kg, and export documentation support, we ensure steady supply for commercial operations.
highlights: Derived from carefully selected Indian neem leaves
Fine 80-100 mesh particle size for smooth blending
Controlled moisture content of eight percent or less
Dehydrated leaf processing preserving natural green color
Extended shelf life of 24 months in proper storage
Complete batch traceability across all production stages
packaging: Custom retail pouches for private label

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for neem powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity starts at 5 Kg for standard orders, accommodating both emerging brands and large manufacturing operations.

faqs.q: What are the standard specifications of the powder?
faqs.a: The product features a dehydrated fine powder with an 80-100 mesh size, moisture content at or below eight percent, and origin in India.

faqs.q: Do you offer private label and custom packaging?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide OEM and private label manufacturing, including custom retail pouches, jars, and customized bulk packaging on request.

faqs.q: Can we request product samples prior to placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide product samples on request to help evaluation teams verify mesh consistency and suitability for formulation.

faqs.q: What packaging formats are available for bulk shipments?
faqs.a: Bulk shipments are packed in 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, or 5 to 10 kg bags designed for secure commercial handling.

faqs.q: Do you assist with international export documentation?
faqs.a: Yes, as an IEC-registered exporter, we offer complete export documentation support to ensure smooth cross-border freight and clearance.
